items.prompt: What median lines follow [2,2,8] when duplicate observations are retained?

options.why: This effectively discards a repeated 2 and changes the empirical ranks.
The sorted prefixes count both copies of 2, so every median here is 2.
The newest observation is not necessarily the middle observation.
Adding identical observations does not double their median.
